race.comment: ZWEIGELT (2) took control a long way from home and kept going for a comfortable win over 2000m at Coffs Harbour last start. Yet to be tried over this distance but showed no signs of stopping at Coffs. In form and worth following. LORD PROTECTOR (8) strung together three top two finishes on the Queensland provincial circuit before failing at Doomben last Saturday. Back in his right grade today so a return to form is expected. AYASAKI (7) tackled the two-mile marathon at the Gold Coast recently and wasn't beaten far. Dour stayer who saves his best for Grafton. Gets weight off most of his rivals after the claim so there is plenty to like about his chances. FULMEN FILOU (1) is new to this trip and hasn't raced for 39 days so probably needs the run, but his excellent Grafton record keeps him on the radar. Last start Casino winner RIGHTEOUS (3) gets a bit of weight relief today and cannot be ruled out.
